ci_support_linux_64_python3.10.____cpyth:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '14'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma9
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.10.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
name: pyjelly
raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.8.0"
  mypy_min: "1.8"
  mypy_not: "1.19"
  rdflib_min: "7.1.4"
  protobuf_min: "6.30.0"
  # TODO: remove if/when oldest supported is available
  protobuf_check_min: "6.31.1"

package:
  name: pyjelly
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/pyjelly/pyjelly-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: b44ccf81998fbf06f1ac582268085af4d44a905a8c9d338cb4d1bcafd919589c
    target_directory: dist
  - url: https://github.com/Jelly-RDF/jelly-protobuf/archive/31e63ebf4bcf53e5cef852fa6dde25b76dcf6c56.tar.gz
    sha256: 03a19f270da9e5162a4aa595e5c1ca0ab3d73b064a3cf8f013e1cfcea113bf40
    target_directory: dist/submodules/protobuf  # (v1.1.3-9-g31e63eb)
  - url: https://github.com/Jelly-RDF/pyjelly/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: c718655fca28fb23e5b680035ef883136fe0e04d438f2cf975248f0f2e307337
    target_directory: src

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    - ${{ PYTHON }} ${{ "$RECIPE_DIR" if unix else "%RECIPE_DIR%" }}/deref_symlinks.py
    - cd dist
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - mypy >=${{ mypy_min }},!=${{ mypy_not }}
        - python
  host:
    - hatch-mypyc
    - hatchling >=1.24
    - mypy >=${{ mypy_min }},!=${{ mypy_not }}
    - pip
    - python
  run:
    - mypy_extensions >=1.0.0
    - protobuf >=${{ protobuf_min }}
    - python
    - typing_extensions >=4.12.2
  run_constraints:
    - rdflib >=${{ rdflib_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports: pyjelly
      pip_check: true
  - files:
      source:
        - src/tests/
        - src/pyproject.toml
    requirements:
      run:
        - coverage
        - hypothesis
        - inline-snapshot
        - pip
        - protobuf ${{ protobuf_check_min }}.*
        - pytest >=8.3.4,<8.5.0
        - pytest-mock
        - pytest-subtests
        - rdflib ${{ rdflib_min }}.*
    script:
      - pip check
      - cd src
      - coverage run --source=pyjelly --branch -m pytest -vv --tb=long --color=yes
      - coverage report --show-missing --skip-covered --fail-under=46

about:
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/pyjelly
  summary: Jelly-RDF implementation for Python
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - dist/LICENSE
    - dist/submodules/protobuf/LICENSE
  documentation: https://jelly-rdf.github.io/pyjelly
  repository: https://github.com/Jelly-RDF/pyjelly

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - bollwyvl
